description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Latvia working-day offset. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when latvia 2026 only. Explicit calendar_basis and work_schedule=mon_fri_planning are required. The transfer basis applies Cabinet Order 330 only when the organization is covered or has adopted it; no private employer adoption is inferred. Section 2 observances do not add rest. Shortening is conditional, not full-day rest. Six-day/shift/personal rosters, other religious calendars, bank/exchange/school opening, payroll, actual hours and legal deadlines are not computed.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts Latvia authority-scope working days in exact coverage. Explicit transfer basis and mon_fri_planning required. Separate statutory rest, non-rest observances, transferred work/rest and conditional shortening.
Example user requests: Add or subtract Latvia working days around Mother's Day is statutory even on Sunday. | Add or subtract Latvia working days around January 2 depends on explicit transfer basis. | Add or subtract Latvia working days around June 27 depends on explicit transfer basis.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer); calendar_basis (enum); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0,"calendar_basis":"statutory_holidays_only","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"start_date":"2026-01-01","working_days":0,"calendar_basis":"cabinet_order_330_transfers","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, calendar_basis, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_non_rest_observance, is_transferred_rest_day, is_transferred_working_day, is_shortened_workday, statutory_shortening_hours, shortening_scope, payroll_scope, personal_roster_scope, working_hours_scope, additional_religious_holidays_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = explicit transferred working date OR (weekday AND no statutory/selected transferred rest); shortened dates count once
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/latvia-public-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/latvia-public-add-working-days.md

calendar_basis.description: Required statutory_holidays_only or cabinet_order_330_transfers. Choose the latter only for a covered institution or an employer adopting the order; never infer adoption.

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday baseline before any selected Order 330 transfers; not a universal or individual roster.

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_lv_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_basis.description: Explicit selected transfer basis; no employer adoption inferred.

calendar_scope.description: Latvia 2026 statutory calendar, explicit statutory_holidays_only and Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: statutory_holiday_rest, transferred_rest_day, special_working_day, shortened_workday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_non_rest_observance.description: Whether result.date has a section 2 observance, which itself does not cause rest.

is_shortened_workday.description: Whether result.date carries a conditional normal-working-time shortening rule, not full-day rest.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a Holiday Law section 1 holiday, excluding transfer-only rest.

is_transferred_rest_day.description: Rest date under the explicitly selected Order 330 basis.

is_transferred_working_day.description: Working Saturday under the explicitly selected Order 330 basis.

statutory_shortening_hours.description: Rule magnitude: one on a shortening date, zero otherwise. Not actual employee hours or entitlement.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only May 4, November 18 and qualifying General Song/Dance Festival closing day have statutory weekend substitution; none triggered in 2026. No blanket substitute Monday.

work_schedule.description: Explicit mon_fri_planning baseline, before selected transfers.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Add Latvia Working Days
